basis: Retained original article, supplement and existing finite native ratio reader reviewed separately.
reference_subject: CsiD, studied in the supplied paper
required_limits: Do not invent independent repetitions, SD, sampling uncertainty or alternative predictions.
A conditional nominal residual can be computed for an explicitly defined same-scale prediction, but full MSE and comparative support require their actual prerequisites.
The product-pair ratio does not establish substrate consumption or oxygen coupling.
Reagent supply and concentration are not automatically usable physiological capacity or amounts.
The supplement PDF and its text projection are one representation lineage, not two experiments.
The supplied anonymous target is real E. coli TPI, not CsiD; unrelated source activity must not transfer to it.
Exact requested saved reaction components must reach and be interpreted by the actual annotation parent.
